warning.titlePre: Range Rover Evoque D150 Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain & EGR Wear
paragraphs: Evoque D150 engines - Ingenium AJ150D and AJ200D, across every Range Rover Evoque generation - commonly show timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks over time. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every Evoque D150 rebuild.
